name: backbone-plugin
description: Backbone agent-driven tenant setup: skills and slash commands that drive configure-to-build through the Backbone MCP server (the hosted service).

backbone_url.title: Backbone URL
backbone_url.description: Base URL of the hosted Backbone service, exactly as Calon gave it to you: it must start with https:// and have no trailing slash. Your token is sent to this address, so never enter an http:// address or any other host.

backbone_token.title: Backbone token
backbone_token.description: Your personal Backbone access token, issued by Calon.
